title: Founding of Solomon’s Temple
summary: Solomon founds the Temple (1 Kgs 6:1). Jones’s word is founding.
description: Solomon founds the Temple (1 Kgs 6:1). Jones’s word is founding. The year is the Appendix F figure, stored as printed.

sorting_basis.note: Tier 3: Ussher-Jones (Floyd Nolen Jones): 1012 BC (no higher-tier year available).

chronologies.citation: Jones, The Chronology of the Old Testament: A Return to the Basics, 23rd ed. (Master Books, 2026), Appendix F, printed p. 279 (PDF p. 314)
chronologies.note: Jones prints founding. temple-dedication keeps the CFAH-1 Table 1 sort at 1012 BC. The 23rd ed. dedication, 1004 BC, is on that record as display only.

chronologies.citation: BLK SHP Scott, Dynasty of Slaves, Introduction, Establishing the Anchor Date
chronologies.note: Fourth year of Solomon, when he says the temple was begun.

chronologies.citation: BLK SHP Scott, Dynasty of Slaves, Introduction, Establishing the Anchor Date
chronologies.note: Interval he counts back from 966 BC. Not converted. He prints the result as 1446 BC.

chronologies.date: there passed 480. yeeres from the deliuerance of Israel out of Aegypt, vnto the building of the Temple
chronologies.citation: Raleigh, The History of the World (1617, EEBO-TCP A10357), Book II, Part I, Chapter VI, §. VIII, sig. 216b
chronologies.note: Body intake. The interval he keeps from the Exodus to the Temple. Not a yeere of the World. It is not converted. year_am stays null. This does not change the sort.
